quantize_model_nvfp4: quantize a large language model to NVFP4 format using llmcompressor oneshot with a QuantizationModifier recipe
load_quantized_model: load a causal language model from HuggingFace with auto dtype and trust_remote_code enabled
calibrate_quantization: calibrate model quantization using a tokenized dataset with specified number of samples and sequence length
generate_text_quantized: generate text from a quantized model after dispatching it with offload support
save_quantized_model: save a quantized model and tokenizer to disk in compressed-tensors format
